item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 04:00 PM 30 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaDelNorte(LeonB.Postigo, Sibutad, DapitanCity, DipologCity, Katipunan, Pres.ManuelA.Roxas, JoseDalman), #DavaoDeOro(Mabini, Maco, Nabunturan, Maragusan, Pantukan, NewBataan), #DavaoOriental(Baganga), #ZamboangaDelSur(Sominot, RamonMagsaysay, Aurora, Bayog), #Bukidnon(Talakag, Pangantucan, Kalilangan, Maramag, ImpasugOng, Libona, Baungon), #SultanKudarat(Bagumbayan, CityOfTacurong, Isulan), #SouthCotabato(Norala, SantoNiño, T'Boli), #AgusanDelSur(Loreto, LaPaz), #MisamisOriental(CagayanDeOroCity), #LanaoDelNorte(IliganCity), #MisamisOccidental(Plaridel and LopezJaena) within the next 1-2 hours.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #MisamisOccidental(SapangDalaga, Concepcion, Baliangao, Calamba, Bonifacio, DonVictorianoChiongbian), #ZamboangaDelNorte(SergioOsmeñaSr., Siayan, Sindangan, Rizal, LaLibertad, Mutia, Piñan, Polanco), #ZamboangaDelSur(Josefina, Molave, Dumingag, Midsalip, Mahayag, Tambulig), #Bukidnon(Sumilao, Lantapan, CityOfMalaybalay and CityOfValencia) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
